summary: WISeKey International Holding filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the appointment of Alexander Hirsch as Group Chief Marketing Officer. Hirsch, formerly Senior Director at Salesforce and Head of Marketing Platforms at the World Economic Forum, will coordinate global marketing across WISeKey and its subsidiaries, including SEALSQ Corp. This is a routine executive appointment, not a forced departure or special situation. No deal terms, shareholder actions, or strategic reviews are involved. The filing is purely an ordinary business announcement, warranting no special-situation classification.
